normative_extracts.quote: While the microtask queue is not empty, pop the oldest microtask and run it.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: V8 drains the microtask queue after every JS task prior to rendering.

production_failures.root_cause: Infinite recursion in Promise.then / queueMicrotask starving Update the Rendering.
production_failures.mitigation: Use setTimeout or scheduler.yield() to yield control back to the main thread.
